description: This file implements the core logic for the DoorBell class and its nested Connector class, handling socket creation, binding, unbinding, and event handling for a doorbell communication system within the Thunder namespace.
external_files: <system headers such as Winsock2.h, ws2tcpip.h, errno>

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell device with socket communication capabilities.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles socket connection, binding, unbinding, and event processing for the DoorBell.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Connector
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket handles and setting socket options.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::~Connector
methods.description: Destructor closing sockets and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the socket, sets socket options, and registers the connector.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Unbind
methods.description: Unregisters the connector and updates internal state.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle for the socket descriptor.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Events
methods.description: Returns the events to monitor for this socket.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Handle
methods.description: Handles the socket events, such as read readiness.

methods.name: DoorBell::DoorBell
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DoorBell with a source name.
